object.attr: stakeholder: a name with no letter a–z and no digit, one written in Greek for example, gives an empty slug, and the name should be kept as typed. Decided on 2026-11-10; the numbering rule then gives view-2 and on.
object.description: If a view's or filter's name gives an empty slug, Mellon shall use view as the slug of a view and filter as the slug of a filter.
